pages.title: Salt
pages.text: Salt is a fundamental material in Hexalia, bridging practical crafting and ritual work. It is most commonly derived from natural growth and refined for magical use.

pages.title: Obtaining Salt
pages.text: Salt is primarily obtained by processing $(l:hexalia:resources/crops#saltsprout)Saltsprout$(/l) using a $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/mortar_and_pestle)Mortar and Pestle$(/l).

pages.title: Ritual Use
pages.text: Salt plays a central role in $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/natures_ritual)Nature's Ritual$(/l). It is often required as part of ritual offerings, forming the foundation for many transformations and processes.

pages.title: On Substitutes
pages.text: Salt is flexible in its use. Any item belonging to common salt tags may be used in its place during crafting or ritual offerings, allowing compatibility with other sources.

pages.title: Salt Block
pages.text: Compressed salt can be formed into blocks for easier storage and transport when working with large quantities.

pages.title: Salt Lamp
pages.text: A crafted light source made from salt. It emits a warm glow and can be placed freely, including hanging from above.

pages.title: On Purification
pages.text: Salt is also used in simple transformations, such as refining otherwise unusable materials into something more practical.
